messages:
Nora (COO): quick follow-up from todays all-hands on hiring + org changes. posting a short playbook and opening this thread for questions: https://redwood.example.com/playbooks/fy26-hiring :wave:

Devon (People Ops): TL;DR: FY26 headcount approved. managers can draft reqs now but roles won't go live until comp bands land (target next Wed). intake form + template in the playbook.

Tess - Eng: are managers allowed to interview internal candidates before bands land? we've got two ICs ready to move teams.

Devon (People Ops): yes — internal interviews ok. mark the intake form field "internal_candidate" and label priority. internal mobility prioritized over external hires.

Rajat - PM: reorg question: will reporting lines change immediately or on a transition timeline?

Nora (COO): transition timeline: org alignment effective now, reporting shifts phased over 8 weeks. no net headcount reduction — mostly scope alignment and one new director role for platform partnerships.

Tess - Eng: for Dedicated infra hires, any geographic constraints? some candidates are EMEA remote.

Devon (People Ops): remote-first allowed unless role requires onsite presence. add location notes on the intake form. legal may need lead time for certain countries.

Rajat - PM: can managers request expedited hires? what's the escalation path?

Devon (People Ops): use intake form and set "priority: expedited"; leadership reviews expedited requests in the weekly hiring sync. DM me for immediate exceptions.

Hiring Bot: Reminder: intake form -> https://redwood.example.com/hr/intake (auto-posted)

Tess - Eng: thanks. last one: recommended interview panel size? trying to avoid burning small teams.

Devon (People Ops): recommended = hiring manager + 2 interviewers; cap at 75 mins. rotating pools advised for small teams.

Nora (COO): thanks folks. I'll monitor this thread for an hour for quick follow-ups. If anything needs a private sync please DM. :thumbsup:
